title: Residue homology commutes with ordinary integral pullback
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a morphism f:X → Y of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], on their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], use the completed integral coefficient sheaves [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] and their ordinary uncompleted derived ringed pullback Lf* [def-sf-ordinary-integral-derived-pullback]. For every object K of the unbounded derived category of completed coefficient module sheaves on Y [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], every n ≥ 0 and q in Z, there is an isomorphism H^q((Lf*K) tensor^L O_E/(uniformizer^(n+1))) ≅ f*H^q(K tensor^L O_E/(uniformizer^(n+1))) [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. The functor on the right is the canonical exact constant-coefficient pro-etale module pullback. Neither derived completeness, constructibility, quasi-compactness nor invertibility of l on the schemes is assumed. Coefficient index zero means exponent one.

proof.text: Choose a cochain representative C of K and an epimorphic flat-term K-flat resolution p:P→C using exists_isKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients. Convert tensor-exact flatness to IsFlatOnSite using siteSheafTensorRightIso. Localizing p gives e:Q(P)≅K. The ordinaryIntegralPullComplexCounit computes ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull on this good representative.

Present ordinary module pullback as algebraic inverse image followed by tensor extension, using the ordinaryTensorPullIso of the construction. Apply isKFlat_ringedToposPullback and transport K-flatness along that isomorphism. The two scalarReductionCounit components are consequently invertible, one on P and one on its ordinary pullback; the quotient-to-homotopy factorization maps turn these into computation isomorphisms on Q(P).

Identify ordinaryIntegralModulePull with IntegralAmbient.pull by their common right adjoint. Apply the finitePullComparison used to build the normalized tower. The finite constant-section right adjoints agree by the ring adjunction triangle identity, so uniqueness of left adjoints identifies integralOperationsLevelPullback with proEtaleConstantModulePullbackFunctor. Map the resulting module comparison to cochain complexes, retaining the composition factorization isomorphisms.

Compose the ordinary computation isomorphism, the scalar computation on pulled P, and the localized cochain square. Apply H^q, the homologyFunctorFactors comparison and proEtaleConstantModulePullbackHomologyIso. Finally apply exact constant pullback to H^q of the inverse scalar computation on P followed by scalar extension of e. This gives exactly the required isomorphism, with no boundedness, completeness, invertibility or nonemptiness assumptions.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryIntegralReductionHomology
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E Y)) (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
      ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj
        ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E f).obj K))) ≅
      proEtaleConstantModulePullback f (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E Y n).obj K)))
